cards.title: One ChopDot recovery and convergence
cards.journey: Mina captures CHF 120 once, Leo and Nina enter through an accepted relationship or scoped invitation, their actions appear automatically for Mina, and one immutable record is saved
cards.blocker: Private v0.5.6 is deployed to `chopdotproof02.dot` with the developer-only Native Host Readiness Check. The exact production asset passed 40/40 adapter tests, TypeScript, build, and the official simulated-host journey. In the real Desktop host, the probe confirmed container, identity, and Statement Store service, opened `Post statements on your behalf`, then stopped at allowance with the visible host error `Submit failed, no allowance set for account`; the product promise separately reported `Unknown enum discriminant: 92`. No canary or money action was published. The scoped Desktop reproduction is now open at `paritytech/polkadot-desktop-community#29` and cross-linked to the existing allowance-integration tracker `paritytech/triangle-js-sdks#167`; both are subscribed. Promotion remains blocked on a supported base-allowance recovery path and a six-stage live `ready` result, then distinct Product Accounts, disconnect/reconnect after both actions, catch-up beyond ChopDot's configured 300-second TTL, general group-action outboxes/publishing, payload/quota compliance, and persisted global event deduplication.
cards.next_action: Run the verified-person ceremony with two real Polkadot App accounts only after the supported signing and storage path is available; keep membership delivery, posting allowance, three-account convergence, artifact freeze, public verification, and deployment separately blocked and action-time gated.

cards.title: Showcase-quality ChopDot entrance
cards.journey: Mina's CHF 120 dinner split is understandable and actionable from the first hosted screen
cards.blocker: Local design and implementation may proceed, but public promotion or deployment remains gated by the applicable P-032 recovery/convergence requirements and action-time approval.
cards.next_action: Preserve the locally passed card experience while Batch 6 freezes and reproves one exact candidate; do not promote or deploy until P-032 live Desktop recovery/convergence and action-time approval pass.

cards.title: Core Money and Event Contract v1
cards.journey: Mina records and corrects one shared expense while Leo and Nina act from different devices, and every device reaches the same exact CHF result
cards.next_action: Preserve the passed exact-money/event contract while Batch 4 routes the ordinary dinner journey through it; re-run P-034 on the exact clean Batch 6 fingerprint and keep the live recovery-provider lane blocked until real Desktop proof.

cards.title: Account, profile, and payment instrument lifecycle
cards.journey: Mina starts safely, becomes the same protected person, maintains her ChopDot/.dot profile, connects a payment method without changing identity, and returns to the same groups after sign-out or device change
cards.blocker: The B6 entrance is still guest-first, Profile says Local profile, provider paths are not wired end to end, and wallet code is primarily a payment-path seam. Product Account identity, verified contacts, guest migration, and recovery foundations exist locally but the complete account/profile/wallet lifecycle has not been assembled and re-proved in one candidate.
cards.next_action: Replace the guest-only entrance with an environment-aware Get started flow and prove that Product Account binding, ChopDot profile, guest migration, sign-out/return, recovery, and payment-wallet connection remain one person with separate authorities.
